constraints: Supports named-function ADDR32 explicit-addend index relocations. Unsupported or incomplete metadata raises ValueError; it is not an empty result.
Relocations inside extab payloads are unresolved rather than compared as raw placeholder bytes.
Record identity/payload equality is not whole-object or final-link equality; extra records require separate link-reachability review.
name: Shared MWCC exception metadata decoder
purpose: Read supported ELF32-BE MWCC exception records by function identity without confusing record order with payload mismatch.
usage: In process: exception_records(elf_bytes) and compare_exception_records(target_records, our_records). No subprocess or build.
